description.text: The Community Entrepreneurship Collaborative (CEC) is a unified pathway from ideation to capital. We equip aspiring entrepreneurs across Dallas and Fort Worth with the skills, documentation, mentorship, and lender connections needed to launch, sustain, and scale businesses that build wealth and opportunity for our community.
